title: Coordinate projection of a product basis function
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\iota$ be finite nonempty sets, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $B$ be a basis of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ whose constant-one element is indexed by $0$ and which is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product. For a positive integer $n$, a multi-index $a\in\iota^n$, and a set of coordinates $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the projection of the product basis function indexed by $a$ onto $J$ equals that product basis function if every coordinate where $a$ is not indexed by $0$ belongs to $J$, and equals zero otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: Finite nonempty basis index set $\iota$ with decidable equality
A basis element indexed by $0$ is constant one
The basis is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product
